title: TrainingTask
description: JSON schema for a training task envelope dispatched to a trainer node.

training_task_id.description: Unique identifier for this specific training task execution.

baseline_model_id.description: Logical identifier of the model architecture and training target.

baseline_model_version.description: Immutable version tag of the baseline model checkpoint.

data_set_shard_id.description: Identifier of the specific dataset shard assigned for training.
